title: Most news apps are designed to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed.
body:
We noticed a pattern in how people consume information. You read a headline, maybe a few sentences, and then you move on to the next thing. You get the update, but you rarely get the context. That is why we built Deep Dive Mode at Headlinne.

Deep Dive Mode isn't about giving you more news. It is about slowing down the process. When you want to understand the 'why' behind a story, you can toggle it on. The app then connects the dots, explains the history, and lays out the different perspectives that usually get buried in a standard feed.

It changes the goal from 'did you see this?' to 'do you understand this?' We believe the future of news isn't about speed. It is about clarity. AI should be a tool that helps us cut through the noise, not one that adds to it.
cta: You can see how it works for yourself at HEADLINNE.com.
